name: no_empty_non_other_fields
rationale: Every entity field other than "other" should have a plausible entity extracted if it appears in the text; completely empty "art", "building", etc., fields are suspicious if matching entities are clearly present in the context.

name: no_field_contains_only_stopwords
rationale: A correct entity must generally contain meaningful tokens, not just stopwords (e.g., "of", "and"). Reject fields where all entities consist solely of stopwords.

name: no_duplicate_entities_across_fields
rationale: The same entity should not appear in multiple fields as it must belong to exactly one field. This constraint helps detect misclassifications.

name: no_field_contains_full_sentence
rationale: Correct entities are token spans, not full sentences. Reject any field containing an entity that matches the entire input text.

name: text_must_contain_all_entities
rationale: Every entity must be directly derived from the text. Reject outputs where any entity does not appear as a substring in the text.

name: no_field_contains_punctuation_only
rationale: Correct entities consist of words, not just punctuation marks. Reject fields containing entities with only punctuation.

name: locations_are_proper_nouns
rationale: Correct location entities are proper nouns (e.g., "Paris"), not generic terms (e.g., "city"). Reject outputs where "location" contains generic terms.

name: no_entities_have_leading_or_trailing_whitespace
rationale: Correct entities are free of leading/trailing spaces. This ensures clean formatting of extracted entities.

name: no_single_letter_entities
rationale: Single-letter entities (e.g., "A") are unlikely to be valid. Reject any field containing such entities.

name: organizations_are_capitalized
rationale: Correct organization names are typically proper nouns and should start with a capital letter. Reject outputs where "organization" contains lowercase entities.

name: no_entities_are_numbers_only
rationale: Entities should not consist solely of numbers (e.g., "123"). Numbers are meaningful only when combined with other context (e.g., "Room 123").

name: no_duplicate_characters_in_entities
rationale: Entities with repeated characters (e.g., "aaaa") are likely invalid. Reject fields containing such entities.

name: no_person_field_with_generic_terms
rationale: The "person" field should not contain generic terms like "man", "woman", or "person". These are not specific named entities.

name: no_empty_entities_in_fields
rationale: Fields should not contain empty strings as entities. Reject any field where an entity is an empty string.

name: no_entities_exceed_text_length
rationale: An entity cannot be longer than the input text. Reject outputs where any entity is longer than the text.

name: no_cross_field_overlap
rationale: The same token span cannot belong to multiple fields. Reject outputs where entities overlap across fields.

name: no_duplicate_entities_across_fields
rationale: Correct outputs never duplicate the same entity across multiple fields. This can catch cases where the same entity is misclassified into more than one category.

name: entities_are_substrings_of_text
rationale: Every correct entity must be a substring of the given text, since entities are extracted directly from the text.

name: no_single_character_entities
rationale: Correct entities are meaningful spans of text, and single-character entities are almost always incorrect.

name: entities_not_whitespace_only
rationale: Correct entities cannot consist solely of whitespace characters; these are invalid outputs.

name: no_repeated_consecutive_words_in_entity
rationale: Correct entities do not have repeated consecutive words (e.g., "New New York"), which are likely model errors.

name: entities_within_reasonable_length
rationale: Correct entities have a reasonable length and are not excessively long (e.g., complete sentences).

name: no_entities_with_unmatched_quotes
rationale: Correct entities do not have unmatched quotes, which indicate likely extraction or formatting errors.

name: no_entities_with_special_characters_only
rationale: Correct entities must contain meaningful text and not consist entirely of special characters.

name: entities_not_split_across_fields
rationale: A correct entity should not be split and appear partially in multiple fields.

name: no_duplicate_words_in_entity
rationale: Correct entities do not have duplicate words within them unnecessarily, e.g., "the the".

name: no_entities_with_leading_or_trailing_punctuation
rationale: Correct entities do not have unnecessary leading or trailing punctuation (e.g., ', entity.').

name: all_entities_case_insensitive_in_text
rationale: Entities should match the text (case-insensitive), as they are direct spans from it.

name: no_field_contains_none_value
rationale: Fields should not contain `None` as an entity, which indicates an extraction error.

name: entities_not_entire_sentence
rationale: Correct entities are not entire sentences; they represent specific spans of interest.

name: no_entities_with_multiple_spaces
rationale: Correct entities do not have multiple consecutive spaces, which indicate formatting errors.

name: no_duplicate_fields_across_output
rationale: Correct outputs do not have the exact same entity list in more than one field, which suggests misclassification.

name: no_entities_with_unnecessary_articles
rationale: Entities should not include unnecessary leading articles (e.g., "the", "a") unless part of a proper name.

name: entities_match_tokenization
rationale: Correct entities must match token boundaries in the text, as they are token spans.

name: no_fields_empty_if_output_nonempty
rationale: If the output contains entities, at least one field should not be empty.

name: entities_with_proper_casing
rationale: Proper nouns/entities usually begin with capital letters, and entities with all lowercase letters are likely errors.

name: no_entities_with_non_alphanumeric_start
rationale: Correct entities do not start with non-alphanumeric characters, which are likely formatting errors.

name: no_empty_output_with_nonempty_text
rationale: If the text contains named entities, the output should not be entirely empty.
